name: ISO Hemlock
description_html:
Rifles imported from fictional firearms manufacturor Expedite Fifearms in Call of Duty, ISO smg’s big brothers:

3 versions are included:

.300BLK

5.56x45

.308

With some barrel, handguard and stock modifications.

Because of the ammo-based damage mechanism, the 5.56 vesion with 600rpm will have a dps as low as the AK-102’s.

Models and textures are properties of Actvision;
